subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the column baseplate between Foundation Plan S-101

messages.text: The column baseplate reinforcement shown in Foundation Plan S-101 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Structural General Notes S-001. This is becoming a priority on our end; we'd appreciate a prompt response. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is not holding any current pour. Please respond within two business days ahead of the scheduled pour.

Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Structural General Notes S-001; Foundation Plan S-101 is superseded. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. This is not holding any current pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- #6 dowels at 12" o.c. -- apply at every column baseplate on this level, not just the one called out in Foundation Plan S-101?
